fields.quote: We used a qualitative study design based on semi-structured interviews.
Data source: interview recordings, transcribed and analysed with thematic coding.

fields.value: Teenagers use social media to keep friendships and try out self-presentation
fields.quote: The main findings show that adolescents use social media mostly to maintain existing friendships and to experiment with self-presentation.
The study is limited to two schools and relies on self-reported accounts, so conclusions about other settings are tentative.

fields.value: Propose a framework linking participation, trust and wellbeing
fields.quote: The aim is theoretical: we review prior literature and propose a framework linking participation, trust and wellbeing.
The framework implies that moderation practices shape wellbeing outcomes.
The framework is untested and needs empirical validation in future work.
